thesis: The speaker recounts his career trajectory from delivering pizzas after graduation to becoming a top mortgage-backed securities analyst at a regional firm, driven by a lifelong passion for strategy games and game theory. He describes the early days of his investment career as engaging in a high-stakes game where he utilized limited computing resources to calculate option-adjusted spreads, treating the market's irrationalities as opportunities similar to those found in board games.
